page_title: BAR 1-2 ATM | Barcelona v Atletico Madrid 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+6' 1 - 2 GOAL! Nahuel Molina finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 1:2.
90+6' Although Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is just on the bench, Ricardo De Burgos has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Barcelona was in an offside position.
90+4' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+4' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle as Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+2' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
88' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
88' Pedri (Barcelona) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
87' Raphinha (Barcelona) launches a cross from the corner, but Jan Oblak is alert to thwart the effort.

86' Jan Oblak pulls off a great save to deny Raphinha (Barcelona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

84' Raphinha (Barcelona) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
83' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
82' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
81' Alejandro Balde pulls the ball back to Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post.
80' The substitution has been made. Eric Garcia (Barcelona) has replaced Marc Casado.
79' Raphinha (Barcelona) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

78' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul. Barcelona are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
74' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside yet again.
73' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) replacing Marcos Llorente.
73' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Griezmann is given a rest as he is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
73' The attendance is 46249.
71' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
69' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
69' The total number of attempts is 11:2. The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.

67' A cross by Raphinha (Barcelona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
66' Raphinha (Barcelona) and Jules Kounde combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
64' Marcus Sorg prepares a substitution. Gavi is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) for Fermin Lopez.
64' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Koke (Atl. Madrid) will replace Conor Gallagher.
62' Here is a change. Giuliano Simeone is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).

60' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Inaki Pena, so the score changes to 1:1.
59' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' The game is interrupted now, Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

57' Raphinha (Barcelona) cracks a splendid volley from just outside the box that brushes the left post. It was an incredible shot and the goalkeeper was really lucky not to concede a goal. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
56' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' Pedri (Barcelona) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.
55' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
54' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
53' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul after Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents. Barcelona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
52' Jose Maria Gimenez is being substituted because of an injury. Diego Simeone sends Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) on the pitch.
51' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a long cross over to Giuliano Simeone, but Inaki Pena comes forward to gather the ball.

48' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak pulls off a brilliant save.
47' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
45+1' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Raphinha (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
43' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) plays a lovely through ball to Julian Alvarez, but he can't beat Inaki Pena and loses the ball.
41' Pedri (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
40' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
39' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
36' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Fermin Lopez collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
35' Total attempts – 5:0. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
32' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
31' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Ricardo De Burgos signals a foul. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
30' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Gavi slips the ball through to Pedri (Barcelona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
27' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends the corner into the box, but Inaki Pena intercepts it and averts the threat.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' A cross from Raphinha gives Gavi (Barcelona) a great chance right in the middle of the box, but he chooses the wrong option and sends a header just wide of the right post.
25' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Raphinha (Barcelona) takes it short.
25' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Barcelona get a corner.
23' The foul by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was seen by Ricardo De Burgos who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

22' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Jan Oblak.
21' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Barcelona! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Ricardo De Burgos and both teams have no complaints.

21' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Barcelona.
21' That looked a certain handball by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
19' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces a cunning chipped pass for Julian Alvarez, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
18' Good movement by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
18' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
18' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) produces a killer pass onto Antoine Griezmann, who loses the ball to one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
16' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.

15' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Fermin Lopez, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
13' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
10' Raphinha received a clever long ball from Pedri (Barcelona) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
10' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
10' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
8' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
7' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
4' What a great touch by Raphinha (Barcelona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
3' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) attempts to find Raphinha, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from Barcelona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
